---
title: "Cook County Electricity Demand Time Series Modeling - Simple Methods"
output: html_document
---

# Load libraries

```{r,warning=F,message=F}
library(forecast)
library(tseries)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL", "en_US.UTF-8")
```

# Load Data

```{r}
df_1819 <- readRDS("df_1819.rds")
df_2020   <- readRDS("df_20.rds")
```

```{r}
ts_1819 <- ts(df_1819$electricity_demand, frequency = 24)
ts_2020 <- ts(df_2020$electricity_demand,
              start = end(ts_1819) + c(0, 1),
              frequency = 24)

h_fc <- length(ts_2020)
level_ci <- 95

dir.create("data/test_forecast", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Modeling

### Simple Methods (Baselines)

```{r}
fc_snaive <- snaive(ts_1819, h = h_fc, level = level_ci)
fc_naive  <- naive(ts_1819,  h = h_fc, level = level_ci)
fc_mean   <- meanf(ts_1819,  h = h_fc, level = level_ci)
fc_drift  <- rwf(ts_1819,    h = h_fc, drift = TRUE, level = level_ci)

acc_snaive <- accuracy(fc_snaive, ts_2020)
acc_naive  <- accuracy(fc_naive,  ts_2020)
acc_mean   <- accuracy(fc_mean,   ts_2020)
acc_drift  <- accuracy(fc_drift,  ts_2020)

baseline_summary <- rbind(
  SNAIVE = acc_snaive["Test set", c("MAE","RMSE","MAPE")],
  NAIVE  = acc_naive ["Test set", c("MAE","RMSE","MAPE")],
  MEANF  = acc_mean  ["Test set", c("MAE","RMSE","MAPE")],
  DRIFT  = acc_drift ["Test set", c("MAE","RMSE","MAPE")]
)

baseline_summary
```

```{r}
autoplot(fc_snaive) + autolayer(ts_2020, series = "Actual") +
  labs(title = "Seasonal Naive: Forecast with 95% Interval", x = "Time", y = "Electricity Demand")

autoplot(fc_naive) + autolayer(ts_2020, series = "Actual") +
  labs(title = "Naive: Forecast with 95% Interval", x = "Time", y = "Electricity Demand")

autoplot(fc_mean) + autolayer(ts_2020, series = "Actual") +
  labs(title = "Mean: Forecast with 95% Interval", x = "Time", y = "Electricity Demand")

autoplot(fc_drift) + autolayer(ts_2020, series = "Actual") +
  labs(title = "Drift: Forecast with 95% Interval", x = "Time", y = "Electricity Demand")
```
### Lightweight models
```{r}
fc_stlf <- stlf(ts_1819, method = "naive", h = h_fc, level = level_ci)
acc_stlf <- accuracy(fc_stlf, ts_2020)
acc_stlf["Test set", c("MAE","RMSE","MAPE")]
```
```{r}
autoplot(fc_stlf) + autolayer(ts_2020, series = "Actual") +
  labs(title = "STLF (naive): Forecast with 95% Interval", x = "Time", y = "Electricity Demand")
```
```{r}
fit_tslm <- tslm(ts_1819 ~ trend + season)
fc_tslm  <- forecast(fit_tslm, h = h_fc, level = level_ci)

acc_tslm <- accuracy(fc_tslm, ts_2020)
acc_tslm["Test set", c("MAE","RMSE","MAPE")]
```
```{r}
library(lmtest)
checkresiduals(fit_tslm)
dwtest(fit_tslm)
bgtest(fit_tslm, order = 24)
```
```{r}
train_tail <- window(ts_1819, start = time(ts_1819)[length(ts_1819) - 336])
autoplot(train_tail) +
  autolayer(fc_tslm$mean, series = "Forecast") +
  labs(title = "TSLM: Last 14 Days of Training and Test Forecast", x = "Time", y = "Electricity Demand")
```

### Export forecasts 

```{r export_forecasts}
get_95 <- function(x) if (is.matrix(x)) x[, ncol(x)] else x

export_forecast_csv <- function(fc_obj, method_name){
  out <- data.frame(
    timestamp = df_2020$timestamp,
    Forecast  = as.numeric(fc_obj$mean),
    Lower     = as.numeric(get_95(fc_obj$lower)),
    Upper     = as.numeric(get_95(fc_obj$upper))
  )
  write.csv(out, paste0("data/test_forecast/", method_name, "_20Jan.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  out
}

export_forecast_csv(fc_snaive, "SNAIVE")
export_forecast_csv(fc_naive,  "NAIVE")
export_forecast_csv(fc_mean,   "MEANF")
export_forecast_csv(fc_drift,  "DRIFT")
export_forecast_csv(fc_stlf,   "STLF")
export_forecast_csv(fc_tslm,   "TSLM")
```
